title.en: Energy and variational view — attention as retrieval and regression
title.zh: 能量与变分视角——注意力作为检索与回归

en.a: Softmax retrieval is the entropy-regularized optimizer on a simplex; modern Hopfield retrieval is an MM/CCCP step for an associative energy.
en.b: Linear attention and Gated DeltaNet can be read as online regressors with different write rules. The correspondence is exact for the stated state updates, not a claim that every attention layer is one optimizer.

zh.a: Softmax 检索是单纯形上的熵正则化优化器；现代 Hopfield 检索是关联能量的 MM/CCCP 步骤。
zh.b: Linear attention 和 Gated DeltaNet 可被视为具有不同写入规则的在线回归器。该对应关系对于所述状态更新是精确的，并非声称每个注意力层都是一个优化器。
